'''R4-M9'''<ref name="R4-M9" /> was an [[R4 astromech droid|R4 astromech]]<ref name="Every Droid in Star Wars" /> that was a part of the [[Galactic Empire]].<ref name="R4-M9" /> It was aboard the ''[[Tantive IV]]'' after it was [[Secret mission to Tatooine|disabled]] in [[orbit]] of the [[planet]] [[Tatooine]].<ref name="A New Hope" />
